Body.Content:
We’ve added additional point-of presence (POP) locations to the Content Delivery Network. The new POP locations are: India
  • Mumbai
  • Bangalore
  • Delhi
  • Chennai
South America
  • São Paulo, Brazil
  • Quito, Ecuador
 For a full list, see the following site: Azure Content Delivery Network POP Locations.
